Governor Newsom Announces Judicial Appointments 1.20.26

January 20, 2026

SACRAMENTO - Governor Gavin Newsom today announced the following judicial appointments:

Sandra Lee Thompson, of Alameda, has been appointed to serve as a Judge in the Alameda County Superior Court. Thompson has served as a Senior Deputy District Attorney at the Alameda County District Attorney's Office since 2013.

Thompson earned a Juris Doctor degree from Boalt Hall School of Law, and a Bachelor of Arts degree from Stanford University.

Thompson previously served as an Associate at Pillsbury Winthrop Shaw Pittman from 2005 to 2012.

Michael James O'Connor, of Ventura, has been appointed to serve as a Judge in the Ventura County Superior Court; he fills a vacancy created by the retirement of Judge Patricia Adams.

O'Connor has served as a Partner at O'Connor and Associates since 2010. O'Connor earned a Juris Doctor degree from Pepperdine University School of Law, and a Bachelor of Science degree from Cal Poly San Luis Obispo.
